_comment: Google reviews of Restaurant Oliveira, supplied by the client and quoted exactly as written (English; the first one is Google's translation from Russian). `yearsAgo` is relative to when they were copied (October 2026).

reviews.author: Natalia Surovtseva
reviews.text: A cozy restaurant with delicious Portuguese and Swiss cuisine. The staff is very friendly, the prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous. You feel right at home here. A personal thank you to every single restaurant employee—you're the best! A special thanks to the owner, Arlindo, who greets guests personally and pays attention to each one. Wishing you prosperity!! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: siraj berry
reviews.text: Super food, super service.. Definitely will recommend to try the Portuguese Authentic dishes and Port wine 😋😋

reviews.author: Maria Galani
reviews.text:
Very good and authentic Portuguese restaurant.
Great for lunch and dinner.
I love their octopus dish, half chicken and grilled shrimps. It's a must visit.

reviews.author: HYEJUNG (Lucia)
reviews.text: So delicious. The service was excellent.
